messages:
maria.gomez: Heads up — SaturnTech (Azure marketplace) reported ~2k events yesterday but partner-side logs show ~200 delivery NACKs and no automatic retries. They asked us to triage before EOD.
partner-billing-bot: ALERT: marketplace-ingest DLQ spike detected (az-us-east). +212 items at 2025-07-24T22:14Z. See /ops/alerts/ingest-az-us-east.
aj_patel: Which topic/consumer? any sample event ids?
maria.gomez: They posted samples to our support thread. Topic = azure-us-east.partner-ingest. Sample id(s): 9f1a2b3c-77e4-4d9f-a8b1-0c3f5e6a1111, 0a2b3c4d-88f5-5e8a-b9c2-1d4e6f7a2222. Payload example pasted below from partner thread:
```json
{
  "id": "9f1a2b3c-77e4-4d9f-a8b1-0c3f5e6a1111",
  "customer_id": "saturn-123",
  "usage": {"tokens": 450, "type": "inference"},
  "timestamp": null,
  "signature": "..."
}
```
ben_thompson: Quick check: consumer az-ingest-consumer shows lag ~310 between committed and latest offsets (offsets ~124550 -> 124860). DLQ count = 210.
aj_patel: Can someone run a 24h breakdown by status (ACK/NACK/PENDING) so we know scope? Quick BQ example: `SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM partner_ingest.events WHERE DATE(received_ts)=CURRENT_DATE()-1 GROUP BY status;`
maria.gomez: Running now, will paste results in a sec.
maria.gomez: Results: ACK: 1,798; NACK: 212; PENDING: 0 (counts for 2025-07-24 UTC).
ben_thompson: DLQ samples show a serialization error: parsing timestamp failed (null). Looks like the partner SDK changed timezone handling and sends explicit nulls instead of ISO strings for older clients.
aj_patel: FYI I pinged SaturnTech PM @john.saturn in their channel and asked for deploy time and SDK version. If they're on 1.2.1 we can expect a flood.
john.saturn: (from partner) confirmed they rolled out v1.2.1 at ~2025-07-24T20:30Z and are seeing the same null-timestamp issues in their logs. They'll produce corrected payloads.
maria.gomez: Proposed plan: 1) Short-term: add a preprocessor on our ingest that normalizes null timestamp -> received_ts to avoid NACKs. 2) Mid-term: partner fixes SDK and resends corrected events / we replay DLQ. 3) Notify billing + ops and track SLA impact.
ben_thompson: I'll open a hotfix PR to the preprocess hook and run a canary in az-us-east (30min ETA for PR -> canary). If DLQ drops we can trigger replay.
aj_patel: I'll coordinate the replay window with SaturnTech and request the corrected payload bundle. Also will ask them for a patch ETA.
maria.gomez: Thanks — action items noted. If DLQ > 50 after 2h, escalate to eng-sre. I'll update partner thread and send a short incident note to #incidents once stable. :+1:
partner-billing-bot: Replay job scheduled (dry-run) at 1755550300 by ops-replay-bot.
